name: AdaBoost Volume Classification
definition: An interactive framework to classify multiple regions of interest from volume data on demand without preprocessing. It uses three stages: Visualize (user labels samples on slices), Training (ECOC framework trains Discrete AdaBoost classifiers on GPU), and Testing (classifiers applied to unlabeled samples for multi-class labeling in rendering).
summary: AdaBoost Volume Classification is an interactive, data-driven method for multi-class volumetric segmentation that avoids voxel dependencies, enabling real-time handling of complex structures without preprocessing.
